title: SKE Crystal Watermelon Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Watermelon Cherry flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid offers a refreshing fusion of juicy watermelon and ripe cherries, delivering a sweet and satisfying vape experience. This flavour combination is perfect for vapers who enjoy a rich fruit taste with a delightful balance of summer fruits. Part of the SKE Crystal Nic Salts range, this e-liquid uses nicotine salts to ensure a smoother throat hit even at higher nicotine strengths, making it ideal for transitioning smokers. The 50VG/50PG ratio is optimally blended for mouth-to-lung vaping, providing a perfect balance of flavour delivery and vapour production. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
